IFC schemas as a graph

Pick a schema. The EXPRESS schemas are parsed here in the browser from the .exp files; the IFC5 schemas are read as IFCX (JSON) from ifcx.dev. Every file is fetched from a pinned address and checked against its SHA-256.

Click a node for its details, double-click it to bring in its neighbours, and Ctrl+click it to open its page in the standard. An IFC4 entity can be compared with IFC5 through the code of bsi::ifc::class.

Loading… If this stays, the page must be served over http (for instance python -m http.server); it does not run from a file.
